from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper extracted from the collection, capturing its identity and citation relationships."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper as written in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of all titles this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate container for all papers extracted from the provided collection."""
    papers: list[Paper] = Field(description="List of all papers found in the collection")
